name: weili-claude-plugins
description: Weili Xu's personal Claude Code plugins: ML-systems documentation, code-analysis, and session-productivity skills.

plugins.name: mlsys-code-walkthrough
plugins.description: Write rigorous ML-systems code walk-through tutorials (Awesome-ML-SYS-Tutorial style): trace key data structures through a lifecycle, function-by-function mutations, mermaid data-flow diagrams, Excalidraw hero figures, commit-pinned permalinks.

plugins.name: resume-codex
plugins.description: Resume work from a local OpenAI Codex session inside Claude Code: discovers Codex threads (state SQLite index + rollout JSONL under ~/.codex, grok-build's discovery contract ported), builds a bounded redacted continuity packet, reconciles it with the live repo before continuing.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Write a self-contained handoff document when wrapping up or pausing a Claude Code session: verified status, done items, reproducible experiments/analyses, todos, decisions, pitfalls, and next steps — so another person or a future session can pick it up cleanly.
